title: Processing continues after you leave
items: Once your video upload is accepted, FUPCJ Server prepares snapshots, queues transcription and sound effects, and continues visual descriptions without keeping Vision open.
Return to your project to retrieve progress and completed results without uploading the video or audio again.
Incomplete visual inspections retry automatically from the last saved frame. Connection loss no longer appears as a paused analysis.
Update FUPCJ Server before uploading with this version. The server must remain running; Gemini approval and existing processing limits still apply.
